# Hire an Engineer

> Open-source agent skill that turns an AI coding tool (Claude Code, claude.ai, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity) into a senior software engineer and full software team for non-technical builders and vibe coders: planning, project structure, persistent project memory, UI/UX, architecture, databases, API integrations, process automation, test-first development, getting unstuck, releases, documentation and cost tracking for your product.

- [README](README.md): what it is, who it's for, install
- [Skill](skills/hire-an-engineer/SKILL.md): core rules and router
- [Install guide](docs/INSTALL.md)
